note: Silhouette scores compare visible boundaries only, not internal geometry, wood, lighting or unseen surfaces. Original controls overall proportions; the accepted side guide directs the head/button join.

internal_features.inspection: Original and selected overlays plus true level head profiles checked against neutral render; topology, junction surface and slit depth independently validated.
internal_features.mitre: The rounded saw slot is cut through the real body at the orientation fitted to the original white stroke.
internal_features.finial: The low button seats directly in a continuous curved mitre. Its top falls below the original tip at the chosen physical height.
internal_features.collars: The front arcs of the three collar rims are registered separately to the original white sprite.
internal_features.lower_body: A wider foot and socket carry a newly tapered stem on the same floor. The common lower turning is retained at a uniform scale.
internal_features.limits: The original and selected reference retain their saved registration. The button and front foot groove still differ. Grain and illumination retain errors away from the reference view.
